Gives the width of the area of a group that gadgets can use, without frame or scroll bars. For [Desktop](Desktop) it is the width of the primary display, including the area under the task bar and start menu.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Client", 10, 10, 200, 150, Desktop(), 15)
; A gadget as wide as the inside of its window fits exactly.
CreateButton "Wide", 0, 0, ClientWidth(win), 24, win
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param group  Handle of a window, panel, tabber, canvas or the desktop. Other gadgets can give meaningless numbers.
@returns The usable width in pixels.
@gap The desktop is as big as the primary display (all of it, not only the area free of the task bar), where there is a display to ask. A window of the operating system has the frame and the title bar of the system, which are not part of its client area; a menu bar or a status bar is.
